reports.content:
# Implementation Plan: Uncomplete (reopen) completed tasks

## 0. Context and deliverable

- **Repository:** KainBain runner (branch `kb/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567`).
- **Feature:** Once a task is completed, the Complete button should become an
  Uncomplete button that restores the task to its pre-completion workflow state,
  where it behaves like any other non-completed task.
- **Deliverable of this stage:** this plan file only
  (`docs/tasks/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`).
  Implementation, tests, and docs updates happen in later stages.
- **Note on survey/idea inputs:** The stage brief points at `SURVEY.md`
  (grill-me survey) and `idea-20261115-222317.md` in this task's docs folder,
  but that folder is empty in this checkout (only `.`/`..` present at plan
  time). This plan therefore treats the survey outcome as **assumed** (Section
  2) and lists the resulting open questions explicitly (Section 6) so they can
  be confirmed before coding.

### Assumed survey decisions (to confirm against SURVEY.md when available)

1. Scope is a symmetric **uncomplete/reopen**, not delete-and-recreate: history
   and timeline are preserved, with a new "Reopened/Uncompleted" entry.
2. The trigger is the **same button position** as Complete: the Complete button
   swaps to Uncomplete once the task is completed (in both the task detail tab
   and the task detail page, which currently duplicate the button).
3. "Restore it to before" means **the workflow state the task had immediately
   before completion** (stage + runnable status), not merely "not completed".
4. Uncomplete uses the **same authorization** as Complete (no new role).
5. No resurrection of execution: a reopened task becomes **runnable/idle**, it
   does not restart a run by itself.

## 1. Principle: make the change easy, then make the change

1. **Seam first, behaviour second.** Extract the duplicated Complete button
   into one shared component and add a pure status-resolution helper with no
   behaviour change, before adding any backend route.
2. **Mirror, don't fork.** `uncompleteTask` mirrors `completeTask` at every
   layer (store delegate, flow transition, route, service method, mutation
   hook) so future changes to one have an obvious counterpart.
3. **Keep non-completed tasks byte-identical.** No change to statuses, history,
   or timeline for tasks that are never uncompleted; `statusBeforeComplete`
   (or equivalent) is only written by the complete path going forward, with a
   derivation fallback for tasks completed before this feature ships.
4. **One call site at a time.** Backend transition + tests, then route/service,
   then one UI surface, then the second UI surface reusing the same component.

## 2. Scope map (grounded in current code)

Research verified the current complete path end to end; the uncomplete path
touches the same surfaces symmetrically:

### Backend / domain

- `api/flow/stageTransitions.js` — `completeTask` (MARK: completeTask, ~line
  603+) sets `status = "completed"`, clears failure/retry flags, pushes a
  `Completed` history entry and a `Completed` timeline row, after
  `interruptLiveRun`. New `uncompleteTask` belongs beside it.
- `api/taskStore.js` — `completeTask` delegate (~line 816) wrapping the flow
  function; add an `uncompleteTask` delegate the same way.
- `api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js` — `POST /tasks/:id/complete` (MARK: Complete
  Task); add `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` with the same
  `resolveAndGuardProject` + 404 pattern.
- `api/flow/index.js` — re-exports flow functions (`completeTask`, ...); add
  the new function to keep the barrel consistent.
- Task status model: `completed` is set in `stageTransitions.js`; surrounding
  code also uses `idle`, `in_stage`, `running_*`, `interrupted`, plus terminal
  neighbours (`WORKTREE_REAPABLE_STATUSES` in `api/work/taskLifecycle.js`
  includes `"completed"`). The exact restore target needs Phase 0 research.

### Frontend

- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskDetailsTabContent.jsx` (~lines 475–519) —
  Complete button, currently rendered only when `task.status !== 'completed'`.
- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskDetailPageContent.jsx` (~lines
  1190–1232) — duplicated Complete button with the same gate.
- `frontend/src/context/useTaskMutations.js` — `completeTask` (~line 350)
  calls `api.completeTask` then `refreshTasks` + success notification;
  add `uncompleteTask` mirroring it.
- `frontend/src/services/work/index.js` (~line 57) — `completeTask` service
  method (`POST /tasks/:id/complete`); add `uncompleteTask`.
- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCard.jsx` — `isCompleted`
  (`task.status === 'completed'`, ~line 127) drives DONE badge/styling and
  hides checkpoint/survey rows; a reopened task must flow back through the
  existing non-completed branches with no special-casing beyond status.

### Out of scope

- Bulk uncomplete, undo-for-any-action, or generic status editing.
- Auto-resuming execution on reopen (task becomes runnable; the user runs the
  next stage explicitly).
- New roles/permissions; API surface test additions beyond the new endpoint.

## 3. Step-by-step plan (research/big pieces first)

### Phase 0 — Contract research (do first; blocks Phase 1 decisions)

1. **Enumerate the status model.** Grep all writers of `task.status` in
   `api/flow`, `api/work`, `api/taskStore.js` and list every reachable status;
   confirm which statuses a task can hold immediately before `completeTask`
   runs (human-gated? mid-run? idle?) by reading callers of the complete
   route and the UI gates.
2. **Decide the restore target.** Two candidate designs; pick one and record
   why:
   - (a) **Snapshot at complete time**: `completeTask` also stores
     `statusBeforeComplete` (+ `stageBeforeComplete`) on the task; uncomplete
     restores them. Exact, but only works for tasks completed after this
     ships — needs a fallback for older tasks.
   - (b) **Derive from history/timeline**: uncomplete reads the last
     non-terminal history/timeline entry to infer stage + status. Works for
     old tasks, but inference can be wrong.
   - Recommended: (a) with (b) as fallback (`idle` + current `currentStageId`
     when neither snapshot nor history yields a target). Confirm against
     SURVEY.md.
3. **Confirm timeline/history conventions.** Read `store._recordTimelineWithDiffStat`
   and `_recordHistory` usage in `completeTask`; decide the reopen entries
   (proposed: history action `"Uncompleted"`/`"Reopened"`, terminal-style
   timeline row `status: "Reopened"` so reports stay coherent).
4. **Check consumers of `completed`.** Search for `=== 'completed'` /
   `!== 'completed'` across `frontend/src` and `api` (board filter
   `excludeCompleted` in `taskWorkRoutes.js`, retrospective stats, survey
   gating) and list each behaviour a reopened task must regain; verify none
   caches terminal state elsewhere (notifications, scheduler stats).

### Phase 1 — Make the change easy (no behaviour change)

1. **Extract a shared task-action button.** Create one component (e.g.
   `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` under `frontend/src/components/tasks/`)
   encapsulating the `pendingAction`/`runTaskAction` + button markup now
   duplicated in `TaskDetailsTabContent.jsx` and `TaskDetailPageContent.jsx`;
   rewire both call sites to it with identical props/behaviour. Validate with
   the existing `TaskDetail*` and `TaskCard` frontend tests (no new tests
   yet; behaviour must be unchanged).
2. **Add a pure status helper.** Add `resolveReopenedStatus(task)` (name TBD,
   beside the flow functions or in `taskLifecycle.js`) implementing the
   Phase-0 decision as a pure function: input task (+ history) → output
   `{ status, stageId? }`, defaulting to `idle`. Unit-test the mapping
   exhaustively (snapshot present, snapshot absent + history present,
   neither present) before any writer uses it.

### Phase 2 — Backend: `uncompleteTask` + route (the change)

1. **Flow transition** in `api/flow/stageTransitions.js`, mirroring
   `completeTask`:
   - Return `null` when task missing; no-op (return task) when status is not
     `completed` — symmetric with complete's early return.
   - Do **not** interrupt or start runs (a completed task has no live run by
     construction); assert/verify no live run rather than stopping one.
   - Set status from `resolveReopenedStatus`, restore `currentStageId` when
     the snapshot/fallback provides one, touch `updatedAt`, push history
     (`Uncompleted`) and timeline (`Reopened`) entries, persist to disk.
   - Clear nothing else destructively: keep prior timeline, reports, and
     survey answers intact.
2. **Store delegate** in `api/taskStore.js` (`uncompleteTask`, same JSDoc
   style as `completeTask`), plus barrel export in `api/flow/index.js`.
3. **Route** `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` in `api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js`,
   copying the complete route's guard/404 shape.
4. **(If Phase 0 chose snapshot)** Extend `completeTask` to persist
   `statusBeforeComplete`/`stageBeforeComplete` before overwriting status.
5. **Tests (backend):**
   - `completeTask` still behaves identically for never-reopened tasks.
   - Uncomplete on missing task → null/404; on non-completed task → no-op.
   - Complete → uncomplete round-trip restores snapshot status/stage and
     appends history + timeline entries.
   - Legacy completed task (no snapshot) falls back to derived/`idle` state.
   - Double-uncomplete is a safe no-op; complete → uncomplete → complete
     works (re-completion re-snapshots).

### Phase 3 — Frontend wiring

1. **Service + mutation:** add `uncompleteTask` to
   `frontend/src/services/work/index.js` (`POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete`) and
   to `useTaskMutations.js` mirroring `completeTask` (refresh + `Task
   Reopened` notification, error log `Failed to uncomplete task`). Extend
   `frontend/src/services/api.surface.test.js` for the new method.
2. **Button swap** in the shared component from Phase 1: when
   `task.status === 'completed'`, render `↺ Uncomplete` (label TBD, confirm
   wording with survey: "Uncomplete" vs "Reopen") wired to the new mutation
   with its own `pendingAction` key (e.g. `'uncomplete'`, separate
   `aria-busy`); otherwise render the existing Complete button unchanged.
   Both detail surfaces inherit the swap automatically.
3. **Card/list coherence:** verify `TaskCard` needs no edit (its
   `isCompleted` branches already key off status); add/extend a
   `TaskCard.test.jsx` case asserting a reopened-status fixture renders the
   non-completed presentation.
4. **Tests (frontend):** mutation hook test (success notification + refresh,
   failure path logs without crashing), button-state test (completed →
   shows Uncomplete; after action shows Complete), accessibility (busy state,
   label).

### Phase 4 — Verification and documentation

1. **Automated gates** (primary gate per repo guidance): `npm run test:unit`
   (api + frontend suites), plus lint for touched packages. If time allows,
   run the full `npm test` runner script path.
2. **Manual/isolated check:** with headless tooling only (no long-lived
   servers; use existing mock fixtures or `npm run capture:screenshot` if a
   visual check is needed): complete a task, confirm the button reads
   Uncomplete, uncomplete it, confirm it behaves like any other task (runnable
   stage actions visible, board filter includes it, retrospective no longer
   counts it completed).
3. **Documentation updates** (part of the change, not an afterthought):
   - User-facing task lifecycle docs: document Uncomplete where Complete is
     described.
   - API surface docs if the repo documents task routes (check
     `agentGuide`/site-docs coverage gates — `docs:check` validates them).
   - CHANGELOG entry if the repo convention covers features.

## 4. Validation plan (how we prove it worked)

| Check | Command / method | Expected evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Backend unit/integration | `npm run test:api` (covers `taskStore`, `stageTransitions`, route tests) | New uncomplete cases green; no regressions in complete/flow tests |
| Frontend unit | `npm run test:frontend` (TaskCard, detail, api.surface suites) | Button-swap and mutation cases green |
| Full unit gate | `npm run test:unit` | Green (primary verification gate) |
| Lint | `npm run lint:api` + `npm run lint:frontend` for touched files | Clean |
| Docs gates | `npm run docs:check` if docs touched | Clean |
| Manual round-trip | Isolated/headless run or fixture-driven check | Complete → Uncomplete → runnable task; board/retrospective coherent |

## 5. Risks and mitigations

- **Wrong restore target** (task reopens into a dead-end stage/status):
  mitigate by snapshotting at complete time (exact) + tested fallback, and by
  Phase 0's consumer audit.
- **Legacy completed tasks** (no snapshot): covered by derivation/`idle`
  fallback + explicit test.
- **Duplicated button drift**: mitigated by extracting the shared component
  before wiring the new action.
- **Reports/analytics double-counting** (a task completed, reopened,
  completed again): timeline entries make each transition explicit; verify
  retrospective stats handle multiple Completed rows or document the caveat.

## 6. Open questions (blocked on missing SURVEY.md / idea file)

1. **Button wording:** "Uncomplete" (task text) vs "Reopen" — confirm the
   survey's chosen label.
2. **Restore target confirmation:** exact pre-completion stage+status (with
   snapshot) vs simply "back to the queue as idle" — confirm Section 0
   assumption 3.
3. **Permissions:** is uncomplete allowed for the same actor as complete, or
   restricted further?
4. **Re-run semantics:** after uncomplete, may the task immediately run the
   next stage, or should it require explicit user action? (Plan assumes the
   latter.)

reports.content:
# Update-safety review: Uncomplete (reopen) — existing installs

- **Branch:** `kb/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567` vs `main` (`93970db0…`)
- **Head:** `6ba182aa` “persist pre-completion snapshot … kick scheduler on reopen”
- **Scope:** 33 files, all additive except `completeTask` snapshot (see below).
  No `package.json`, env, config, runner, or deploy changes.
- **Question:** does this break existing installs on update (startup crash,
  task loss, corruption, wedged scheduler)? **Verdict: PASS — no break found.**
  This file is the audit trail; the stage verdict is in the final message.

## 1. Persisted `task.md` frontmatter — the main install risk

- New fields `statusBeforeComplete` / `stageBeforeComplete` in
  `api/work/taskPersistence.js` `saveTaskMarkdown` are written **only when
  truthy** (`...(task.statusBeforeComplete ? […] : [])`). `null`,
  `undefined`, and `""` all omit the line. `createTask`
  (`api/work/taskLifecycle.js`) never initializes them, and `uncompleteTask`
  clears them to `null`, so a never-completed or reopened task re-saves
  byte-identical to pre-feature shape (except additive history/timeline).
- `parseTaskMarkdown` reads them as `data.statusBeforeComplete || null`.
  Absent on legacy files → `null`, no throw. Verified in memory:
  legacy file parses to `status: completed, currentStageId: stage-3,
  snapshot: null/null`; file with `paused/stage-2` parses back exactly.
- `_parseFrontmatter` (`api/work/taskFiles.js`) is unchanged from `main`
  (verified via `git show main:…`): it maps every `key: value` line into
  `data`. Old code therefore **ignores** the two new keys rather than
  rejecting them; new code **defaults** missing keys to `null`. Both
  directions are tolerant. Downgrade note: old code re-saving a new
  completed file drops the snapshot lines but preserves
  `status: completed` — the task stays completed, only the reopen fidelity
  is lost. That is acceptable downgrade loss, not corruption.
- Quoting reuses the existing `_formatFrontmatterValue` channel already used
  for `currentStageId` (escape `\` then `”`, quote wrapping). Round-trip
  verified, including quoted-stage edge case.

## 2. `completeTask` / `uncompleteTask` semantics

- `completeTask` (`api/flow/stageTransitions.js`) early-returns when already
  `completed`, so **legacy completed tasks are never mutated** on first
  `completeTask`/`scanTasks`/save after upgrade. Verified: re-complete is
  same-object no-op, history length and snapshot unchanged.
- `resolveReopenedStatus` (`api/flow/stagePolicy.js`) is pure and total:
  `null` → `{ idle, null }`; legacy completed → `{ idle, currentStageId }`;
  `running_*` snapshot → `{ in_stage, … }`; terminal snapshot
  (`completed/done/failed/cancelled` via `isTerminalTaskStatus`) → `idle`;
  whitespace snapshot → `idle`. Verified for all six cases.
- `uncompleteTask` returns `null` for missing, same task for non-completed
  (mirrors `completeTask` idempotence), pushes one `Uncompleted` history and
  one `Reopened` timeline row, never interrupts/starts a run. Verified:
  complete → uncomplete restores `paused/s-1`, clears snapshot to
  `null/null`, double-uncomplete stays a no-op (one `Uncompleted` entry).

## 3. Other consumers — no break

- **Route:** `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` (`api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js`)
  mirrors `complete`: same `resolveAndGuardProject`, same 404 shape, additive
  path (no shadowing of `/tasks/:id`). Old clients never call it; new
  frontend call failure is caught and logged (`useTaskMutations.js`), not a crash.
- **Timeline/history:** `Reopened` rows carry `duration: "--"`,
  `durationSeconds: undefined`. `shared/stageDurations.js`
  `parseDuration("--")` → `null` and is ignored; `runAttribution.js`
  `isArrivalTimelineRowStatus("Reopened")` → `false` (not an arrival, never
  stamped); frontend `timelineDotClass`/`timelineTextClass` fall through to
  `bg-secondary`/`text-secondary`. `timelineMetadata` JSON round-trips the
  `Reopened` row (verified in memory). History `Uncompleted` has no enum
  consumer that would reject it.
- **Scheduler:** `TaskStore.uncompleteTask` runs the existing
  `_kickIfRunnable` → `kickIfRunnable` (`api/work/kickIfRunnable.js`), which
  only kicks on `in_stage` and never throws. Unknown/stale restored stage
  safely parks: `findNextCandidateTask` skips `stageIndex === -1`.
  `WORKTREE_REAPABLE_STATUSES` handling is unchanged; a missing worktree is
  re-provisioned on next pickup (`ensureTaskWorktree`).
- **Startup:** `scanTasks` (`api/work/taskLifecycle.js`) just parses + syncs
  reports; `ORPHANED_RUNNING_STATUSES` recovery is untouched. Completed
  tasks are never auto-resumed. Board `excludeCompleted`
  (`api/work/taskWorkRoutes.js`) and `isTaskBlocked` keep keying on
  `status !== "completed"`, so a reopened task correctly reappears / re-blocks.
- **Summaries:** `toTaskSummary` (`api/work/taskIdentity.js`) passes `…rest`
  through, so summaries now carry `statusBeforeComplete: null|string` additively.
  Old frontends ignore unknown JSON fields; no strict-equality consumer found.
- **Frontend:** `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` preserves the old Complete
  rendering for non-completed tasks (same default classes; detail-page call
  site keeps its `px-4` override). `disabled={isMutating || pendingAction ===
  action}` is equivalent to the old `disabled={isMutating}` because
  `isMutating === pendingAction !== null` in both shells. Wiring
  (overlay → details tab, detail page, context) is complete; `testUtils` stub updated.
- **Docs:** `api/agentGuide.js` endpoint + `site-docs/api-reference.md` and
  `site-docs/pipeline-stages.md` additions are additive.

## 4. Evidence

- Inline Node (no files written): legacy/new parse, save-conditional,
  `resolveReopenedStatus` ×6, `complete`/`uncomplete` idempotence + missing
  + legacy→`idle`, `kickIfRunnable` never-throws.
- Targeted suites at HEAD (observed): `work/taskPersistence.test.js` 74 pass;
  `flow/stagePolicy.test.js` + `flow/stageTransitions.test.js` 88 pass;
  `routes/tasks.test.js` 38 pass; `taskStore.test.js` 160 pass;
  `TaskCompleteToggleButton.test.jsx` 5 pass. Prior full-run report
  (`automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md`) showed API PASS; its two
  frontend failures (104-vs-105 count, undisabled busy button) were fixed in
  `b125fbbd` and the JSDoc baseline now reads
  `PASS (680 missing, baseline (680 grandfathered))`.

## 5. Intended behaviour changes (not breaks)

- `running_*` snapshot reopens as `in_stage` (completing killed the run).
- Terminal snapshot collapses to `idle`; reopened `waiting_human` loses its
  prior `autoApproveAt` deadline (waits for explicit operator action).
- `enteredStageAt` is not reset on reopen, so duration analytics may show a
  long `timeInStage` for the revisited stage. Only affects tasks that use
  Uncomplete; existing untouched tasks are unaffected.

## 6. Conclusion

No startup crash, data loss, scheduler wedge, or API/frontend break on update
was found. Existing completed, failed, paused, and queued tasks load and
behave as before; only tasks completed **after** the update carry a snapshot,
and only an explicit Uncomplete action reopens them. **PASS.**

reports.name: review-uncomplete-20261116.md
reports.content:
# PR Review: Uncomplete (reopen) completed tasks

- **Branch:** `kb/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567` vs `main`, HEAD `3cbcc811`
- **Reviewer stance:** assumed broken until proven otherwise; verified by reading
  the diff and re-running the gates at HEAD.
- **Prior inputs read:** `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`, `SURVEY.md` (unanswered),
  `review-plan-20261115-223712.md` (PASSED),
  `automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md` (FAILED, pre-fix),
  `UPDATE_SAFETY_REVIEW.md` (PASS).

## Verdict inputs: the CI failure is fully explained and fixed

The failed CI run tested code *before* `b125fbbd` + `6ba182aa`. All three of its
failures are resolved at HEAD — re-verified in this review, not taken on trust:

| CI failure | Fix | Re-verified at HEAD |
|---|---|---|
| `domainRequests` expected 104 ops, got 105 | count updated to 105 with comment | `domainRequests.test.js`: 30/30 pass |
| Busy `Uncomplete` button not disabled | `disabled={isMutating \|\| pendingAction === action}` | `TaskCompleteToggleButton.test.jsx`: 5/5 pass |
| JSDoc baseline missing the new file's default export | MARK + `@example` block added for the default export | `node --test tests/check-jsdoc-example.test.mjs`: 14/14 pass |

Full gates re-run in this review (read-only, no servers, no live-op contact):

- Full frontend suite: **347 files / 4734 tests pass** (was 2 failed / 4732 passed).
- API suites covering the change (`stagePolicy`, `stageTransitions`, `routes/tasks`,
  `taskStore`, `taskPersistence`): **360/360 pass**. Full API suite passed in the
  CI run itself; the change since is additive and covered by these files.
- ESLint on all touched frontend + API files: **0 errors**.

## Review questions

- **Does it achieve the goal?** Yes. On a completed task the same button position
  renders `Uncomplete` (both the details tab and the detail page, via one shared
  component); `uncompleteTask` restores the snapshotted pre-completion
  status/stage and the task flows through existing non-completed branches
  (`TaskCard`, board filter, `isTaskBlocked`) with no special-casing.
- **Did it follow the plan?** Yes. Shared `TaskCompleteToggleButton` (no button
  drift — both old duplicated blocks deleted), pure `resolveReopenedStatus`,
  mirror-at-every-layer backend (`stageTransitions` → `taskStore` → barrel →
  route → service → mutation → context), snapshot-with-`idle` fallback exactly
  as Phase 0 specified, plus the docs Phase 4 required.
- **Code standards?** Yes. MARK/JSDoc blocks with `@example` on every new
  export, same guard/404 shape on the route, symmetric idempotent no-ops
  (missing → null/404; non-completed → no-op), lint clean.
- **Easy to modify later?** Yes. The pure resolver isolates restore policy;
  the mirror structure makes the next change to `completeTask` visibly paired.
- **Best practices / tech debt?** No new debt. No run is interrupted or started
  on reopen; no destructive clearing (reports, surveys intact); snapshot is
  consumed on use and re-stamped on re-complete; `Reopened` timeline rows are
  ignored by `stageDurations`/`runAttribution` fallbacks; scheduler kick reuses
  the existing `_kickIfRunnable` path. `disabled` is slightly stricter than the
  old `disabled={isMutating}` (also true during its own pending key) — an
  improvement to the single-flight guard, covered by test.
- **Docs updated?** Yes. `site-docs/api-reference.md`,
  `site-docs/pipeline-stages.md`, `api/agentGuide.js`. No CHANGELOG entry
  needed: the repo convention curates that file at release time only.

## Known non-issues (checked, not defects)

- The survey was never answered, so button wording ("Uncomplete") and
  no-confirm behavior rest on the plan's stated assumptions. They are
  consistent with the existing Complete behavior (same position, no confirm),
  so this is not a blocker — but human review should confirm the wording.
- The plan's retrospective double-count risk does not materialize: the
  retrospective service is a chat API with no completed-count, and duration

8|  task loss, corruption, wedged scheduler)? **Verdict: PASS — no break found.**
9|  This file is the audit trail; the stage verdict is in the final message.
10|
11|## 1. Persisted `task.md` frontmatter — the main install risk
12|
13|- New fields `statusBeforeComplete` / `stageBeforeComplete` in
14|  `api/work/taskPersistence.js` `saveTaskMarkdown` are written **only when
15|  truthy** (`...(task.statusBeforeComplete ? […] : [])`). `null`,
16|  `undefined`, and `""` all omit the line. `createTask`
17|  (`api/work/taskLifecycle.js`) never initializes them, and `uncompleteTask`
18|  clears them to `null`, so a never-completed or reopened task re-saves
19|  byte-identical to pre-feature shape (except additive history/timeline).
20|- `parseTaskMarkdown` reads them as `data.statusBeforeComplete || null`.
21|  Absent on legacy files → `null`, no throw. Verified in memory:
22|  legacy file parses to `status: completed, currentStageId: stage-3,
23|  snapshot: null/null`; file with `paused/stage-2` parses back exactly.
24|- `_parseFrontmatter` (`api/work/taskFiles.js`) is unchanged from `main`
25|  (verified via `git show main:…`): it maps every `key: value` line into
26|  `data`. Old code therefore **ignores** the two new keys rather than
27|  rejecting them; new code **defaults** missing keys to `null`. Both
28|  directions are tolerant. Downgrade note: old code re-saving a new
29|  completed file drops the snapshot lines but preserves
30|  `status: completed` — the task stays completed, only the reopen fidelity
31|  is lost. That is acceptable downgrade loss, not corruption.
32|- Quoting reuses the existing `_formatFrontmatterValue` channel already used
33|  for `currentStageId` (escape `\` then `”`, quote wrapping). Round-trip
34|  verified, including quoted-stage edge case.
35|
36|## 2. `completeTask` / `uncompleteTask` semantics
37|
38|- `completeTask` (`api/flow/stageTransitions.js`) early-returns when already
39|  `completed`, so **legacy completed tasks are never mutated** on first
40|  `completeTask`/`scanTasks`/save after upgrade. Verified: re-complete is
41|  same-object no-op, history length and snapshot unchanged.
42|- `resolveReopenedStatus` (`api/flow/stagePolicy.js`) is pure and total:
43|  `null` → `{ idle, null }`; legacy completed → `{ idle, currentStageId }`;
44|  `running_*` snapshot → `{ in_stage, … }`; terminal snapshot
45|  (`completed/done/failed/cancelled` via `isTerminalTaskStatus`) → `idle`;
46|  whitespace snapshot → `idle`. Verified for all six cases.
47|- `uncompleteTask` returns `null` for missing, same task for non-completed
48|  (mirrors `completeTask` idempotence), pushes one `Uncompleted` history and
49|  one `Reopened` timeline row, never interrupts/starts a run. Verified:
50|  complete → uncomplete restores `paused/s-1`, clears snapshot to
51|  `null/null`, double-uncomplete stays a no-op (one `Uncompleted` entry).
52|
53|## 3. Other consumers — no break
54|
55|- **Route:** `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` (`api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js`)
56|  mirrors `complete`: same `resolveAndGuardProject`, same 404 shape, additive
57|  path (no shadowing of `/tasks/:id`). Old clients never call it; new
58|  frontend call failure is caught and logged (`useTaskMutations.js`), not a crash.
59|- **Timeline/history:** `Reopened` rows carry `duration: "--"`,
60|  `durationSeconds: undefined`. `shared/stageDurations.js`
61|  `parseDuration("--")` → `null` and is ignored; `runAttribution.js`
62|  `isArrivalTimelineRowStatus("Reopened")` → `false` (not an arrival, never
63|  stamped); frontend `timelineDotClass`/`timelineTextClass` fall through to
64|  `bg-secondary`/`text-secondary`. `timelineMetadata` JSON round-trips the
65|  `Reopened` row (verified in memory). History `Uncompleted` has no enum
66|  consumer that would reject it.
67|- **Scheduler:** `TaskStore.uncompleteTask` runs the existing
68|  `_kickIfRunnable` → `kickIfRunnable` (`api/work/kickIfRunnable.js`), which
69|  only kicks on `in_stage` and never throws. Unknown/stale restored stage
70|  safely parks: `findNextCandidateTask` skips `stageIndex === -1`.
71|  `WORKTREE_REAPABLE_STATUSES` handling is unchanged; a missing worktree is
72|  re-provisioned on next pickup (`ensureTaskWorktree`).
73|- **Startup:** `scanTasks` (`api/work/taskLifecycle.js`) just parses + syncs
74|  reports; `ORPHANED_RUNNING_STATUSES` recovery is untouched. Completed
75|  tasks are never auto-resumed. Board `excludeCompleted`
76|  (`api/work/taskWorkRoutes.js`) and `isTaskBlocked` keep keying on
77|  `status !== "completed"`, so a reopened task correctly reappears / re-blocks.
78|- **Summaries:** `toTaskSummary` (`api/work/taskIdentity.js`) passes `…rest`
79|  through, so summaries now carry `statusBeforeComplete: null|string` additively.
80|  Old frontends ignore unknown JSON fields; no strict-equality consumer found.
81|- **Frontend:** `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` preserves the old Complete
82|  rendering for non-completed tasks (same default classes; detail-page call
83|  site keeps its `px-4` override). `disabled={isMutating || pendingAction ===
84|  action}` is equivalent to the old `disabled={isMutating}` because
85|  `isMutating === pendingAction !== null` in both shells. Wiring
86|  (overlay → details tab, detail page, context) is complete; `testUtils` stub updated.
87|- **Docs:** `api/agentGuide.js` endpoint + `site-docs/api-reference.md` and
88|  `site-docs/pipeline-stages.md` additions are additive.
89|
90|## 4. Evidence
91|
92|- Inline Node (no files written): legacy/new parse, save-conditional,
93|  `resolveReopenedStatus` ×6, `complete`/`uncomplete` idempotence + missing
94|  + legacy→`idle`, `kickIfRunnable` never-throws.
95|- Targeted suites at HEAD (observed): `work/taskPersistence.test.js` 74 pass;
96|  `flow/stagePolicy.test.js` + `flow/stageTransitions.test.js` 88 pass;
97|  `routes/tasks.test.js` 38 pass; `taskStore.test.js` 160 pass;
98|  `TaskCompleteToggleButton.test.jsx` 5 pass. Prior full-run report
99|  (`automated-tests-failure-20261115-232533.md`) showed API PASS; its two
100|  frontend failures (104-vs-105 count, undisabled busy button) were fixed in
101|  `b125fbbd` and the JSDoc baseline now reads
102|  `PASS (680 missing, baseline (680 grandfathered))`.
103|
104|## 5. Intended behaviour changes (not breaks)
105|
106|- `running_*` snapshot reopens as `in_stage` (completing killed the run).
107|- Terminal snapshot collapses to `idle`; reopened `waiting_human` loses its
108|  prior `autoApproveAt` deadline (waits for explicit operator action).
109|- `enteredStageAt` is not reset on reopen, so duration analytics may show a
110|  long `timeInStage` for the revisited stage. Only affects tasks that use
111|  Uncomplete; existing untouched tasks are unaffected.
112|
113|## 6. Conclusion
114|
115|No startup crash, data loss, scheduler wedge, or API/frontend break on update
116|was found. Existing completed, failed, paused, and queued tasks load and
117|behave as before; only tasks completed **after** the update carry a snapshot,
118|and only an explicit Uncomplete action reopens them. **PASS.**

1|# Implementation Plan: Uncomplete (reopen) completed tasks
2|
3|## 0. Context and deliverable
4|
5|- **Repository:** KainBain runner (branch `kb/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567`).
6|- **Feature:** Once a task is completed, the Complete button should become an
7|  Uncomplete button that restores the task to its pre-completion workflow state,
8|  where it behaves like any other non-completed task.
9|- **Deliverable of this stage:** this plan file only
10|  (`docs/tasks/cccd8b9d-9021-4d0f-b51c-26d489073567/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`).
11|  Implementation, tests, and docs updates happen in later stages.
12|- **Note on survey/idea inputs:** The stage brief points at `SURVEY.md`
13|  (grill-me survey) and `idea-20261115-222317.md` in this task's docs folder,
14|  but that folder is empty in this checkout (only `.`/`..` present at plan
15|  time). This plan therefore treats the survey outcome as **assumed** (Section
16|  2) and lists the resulting open questions explicitly (Section 6) so they can
17|  be confirmed before coding.
18|
19|### Assumed survey decisions (to confirm against SURVEY.md when available)
20|
21|1. Scope is a symmetric **uncomplete/reopen**, not delete-and-recreate: history
22|   and timeline are preserved, with a new "Reopened/Uncompleted" entry.
23|2. The trigger is the **same button position** as Complete: the Complete button
24|   swaps to Uncomplete once the task is completed (in both the task detail tab
25|   and the task detail page, which currently duplicate the button).
26|3. "Restore it to before" means **the workflow state the task had immediately
27|   before completion** (stage + runnable status), not merely "not completed".
28|4. Uncomplete uses the **same authorization** as Complete (no new role).
29|5. No resurrection of execution: a reopened task becomes **runnable/idle**, it
30|   does not restart a run by itself.
31|
32|## 1. Principle: make the change easy, then make the change
33|
34|1. **Seam first, behaviour second.** Extract the duplicated Complete button
35|   into one shared component and add a pure status-resolution helper with no
36|   behaviour change, before adding any backend route.
37|2. **Mirror, don't fork.** `uncompleteTask` mirrors `completeTask` at every
38|   layer (store delegate, flow transition, route, service method, mutation
39|   hook) so future changes to one have an obvious counterpart.
40|3. **Keep non-completed tasks byte-identical.** No change to statuses, history,
41|   or timeline for tasks that are never uncompleted; `statusBeforeComplete`
42|   (or equivalent) is only written by the complete path going forward, with a
43|   derivation fallback for tasks completed before this feature ships.
44|4. **One call site at a time.** Backend transition + tests, then route/service,
45|   then one UI surface, then the second UI surface reusing the same component.
46|
47|## 2. Scope map (grounded in current code)
48|
49|Research verified the current complete path end to end; the uncomplete path
50|touches the same surfaces symmetrically:
51|
52|### Backend / domain
53|
54|- `api/flow/stageTransitions.js` — `completeTask` (MARK: completeTask, ~line
55|  603+) sets `status = "completed"`, clears failure/retry flags, pushes a
56|  `Completed` history entry and a `Completed` timeline row, after
57|  `interruptLiveRun`. New `uncompleteTask` belongs beside it.
58|- `api/taskStore.js` — `completeTask` delegate (~line 816) wrapping the flow
59|  function; add an `uncompleteTask` delegate the same way.
60|- `api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js` — `POST /tasks/:id/complete` (MARK: Complete
61|  Task); add `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` with the same
62|  `resolveAndGuardProject` + 404 pattern.
63|- `api/flow/index.js` — re-exports flow functions (`completeTask`, ...); add
64|  the new function to keep the barrel consistent.
65|- Task status model: `completed` is set in `stageTransitions.js`; surrounding
66|  code also uses `idle`, `in_stage`, `running_*`, `interrupted`, plus terminal
67|  neighbours (`WORKTREE_REAPABLE_STATUSES` in `api/work/taskLifecycle.js`
68|  includes `"completed"`). The exact restore target needs Phase 0 research.
69|
70|### Frontend
71|
72|- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskDetailsTabContent.jsx` (~lines 475–519) —
73|  Complete button, currently rendered only when `task.status !== 'completed'`.
74|- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskDetailPageContent.jsx` (~lines
75|  1190–1232) — duplicated Complete button with the same gate.
76|- `frontend/src/context/useTaskMutations.js` — `completeTask` (~line 350)
77|  calls `api.completeTask` then `refreshTasks` + success notification;
78|  add `uncompleteTask` mirroring it.
79|- `frontend/src/services/work/index.js` (~line 57) — `completeTask` service
80|  method (`POST /tasks/:id/complete`); add `uncompleteTask`.
81|- `frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskCard.jsx` — `isCompleted`
82|  (`task.status === 'completed'`, ~line 127) drives DONE badge/styling and
83|  hides checkpoint/survey rows; a reopened task must flow back through the
84|  existing non-completed branches with no special-casing beyond status.
85|
86|### Out of scope
87|
88|- Bulk uncomplete, undo-for-any-action, or generic status editing.
89|- Auto-resuming execution on reopen (task becomes runnable; the user runs the
90|  next stage explicitly).
91|- New roles/permissions; API surface test additions beyond the new endpoint.
92|
93|## 3. Step-by-step plan (research/big pieces first)
94|
95|### Phase 0 — Contract research (do first; blocks Phase 1 decisions)
96|
97|1. **Enumerate the status model.** Grep all writers of `task.status` in
98|   `api/flow`, `api/work`, `api/taskStore.js` and list every reachable status;
99|   confirm which statuses a task can hold immediately before `completeTask`
100|   runs (human-gated? mid-run? idle?) by reading callers of the complete
101|   route and the UI gates.
102|2. **Decide the restore target.** Two candidate designs; pick one and record
103|   why:
104|   - (a) **Snapshot at complete time**: `completeTask` also stores
105|     `statusBeforeComplete` (+ `stageBeforeComplete`) on the task; uncomplete
106|     restores them. Exact, but only works for tasks completed after this
107|     ships — needs a fallback for older tasks.
108|   - (b) **Derive from history/timeline**: uncomplete reads the last
109|     non-terminal history/timeline entry to infer stage + status. Works for
110|     old tasks, but inference can be wrong.
111|   - Recommended: (a) with (b) as fallback (`idle` + current `currentStageId`
112|     when neither snapshot nor history yields a target). Confirm against
113|     SURVEY.md.
114|3. **Confirm timeline/history conventions.** Read `store._recordTimelineWithDiffStat`
115|   and `_recordHistory` usage in `completeTask`; decide the reopen entries
116|   (proposed: history action `"Uncompleted"`/`"Reopened"`, terminal-style
117|   timeline row `status: "Reopened"` so reports stay coherent).
118|4. **Check consumers of `completed`.** Search for `=== 'completed'` /
119|   `!== 'completed'` across `frontend/src` and `api` (board filter
120|   `excludeCompleted` in `taskWorkRoutes.js`, retrospective stats, survey
121|   gating) and list each behaviour a reopened task must regain; verify none
122|   caches terminal state elsewhere (notifications, scheduler stats).
123|
124|### Phase 1 — Make the change easy (no behaviour change)
125|
126|1. **Extract a shared task-action button.** Create one component (e.g.
127|   `TaskCompleteToggleButton.jsx` under `frontend/src/components/tasks/`)
128|   encapsulating the `pendingAction`/`runTaskAction` + button markup now
129|   duplicated in `TaskDetailsTabContent.jsx` and `TaskDetailPageContent.jsx`;
130|   rewire both call sites to it with identical props/behaviour. Validate with
131|   the existing `TaskDetail*` and `TaskCard` frontend tests (no new tests
132|   yet; behaviour must be unchanged).
133|2. **Add a pure status helper.** Add `resolveReopenedStatus(task)` (name TBD,
134|   beside the flow functions or in `taskLifecycle.js`) implementing the
135|   Phase-0 decision as a pure function: input task (+ history) → output
136|   `{ status, stageId? }`, defaulting to `idle`. Unit-test the mapping
137|   exhaustively (snapshot present, snapshot absent + history present,
138|   neither present) before any writer uses it.
139|
140|### Phase 2 — Backend: `uncompleteTask` + route (the change)
141|
142|1. **Flow transition** in `api/flow/stageTransitions.js`, mirroring
143|   `completeTask`:
144|   - Return `null` when task missing; no-op (return task) when status is not
145|     `completed` — symmetric with complete's early return.
146|   - Do **not** interrupt or start runs (a completed task has no live run by
147|     construction); assert/verify no live run rather than stopping one.
148|   - Set status from `resolveReopenedStatus`, restore `currentStageId` when
149|     the snapshot/fallback provides one, touch `updatedAt`, push history
150|     (`Uncompleted`) and timeline (`Reopened`) entries, persist to disk.
151|   - Clear nothing else destructively: keep prior timeline, reports, and
152|     survey answers intact.
153|2. **Store delegate** in `api/taskStore.js` (`uncompleteTask`, same JSDoc
154|   style as `completeTask`), plus barrel export in `api/flow/index.js`.
155|3. **Route** `POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete` in `api/flow/taskFlowRoutes.js`,
156|   copying the complete route's guard/404 shape.
157|4. **(If Phase 0 chose snapshot)** Extend `completeTask` to persist
158|   `statusBeforeComplete`/`stageBeforeComplete` before overwriting status.
159|5. **Tests (backend):**
160|   - `completeTask` still behaves identically for never-reopened tasks.
161|   - Uncomplete on missing task → null/404; on non-completed task → no-op.
162|   - Complete → uncomplete round-trip restores snapshot status/stage and
163|     appends history + timeline entries.
164|   - Legacy completed task (no snapshot) falls back to derived/`idle` state.
165|   - Double-uncomplete is a safe no-op; complete → uncomplete → complete
166|     works (re-completion re-snapshots).
167|
168|### Phase 3 — Frontend wiring
169|
170|1. **Service + mutation:** add `uncompleteTask` to
171|   `frontend/src/services/work/index.js` (`POST /tasks/:id/uncomplete`) and
172|   to `useTaskMutations.js` mirroring `completeTask` (refresh + `Task
173|   Reopened` notification, error log `Failed to uncomplete task`). Extend
174|   `frontend/src/services/api.surface.test.js` for the new method.
175|2. **Button swap** in the shared component from Phase 1: when
176|   `task.status === 'completed'`, render `↺ Uncomplete` (label TBD, confirm
177|   wording with survey: "Uncomplete" vs "Reopen") wired to the new mutation
178|   with its own `pendingAction` key (e.g. `'uncomplete'`, separate
179|   `aria-busy`); otherwise render the existing Complete button unchanged.
180|   Both detail surfaces inherit the swap automatically.
181|3. **Card/list coherence:** verify `TaskCard` needs no edit (its
182|   `isCompleted` branches already key off status); add/extend a
183|   `TaskCard.test.jsx` case asserting a reopened-status fixture renders the
184|   non-completed presentation.
185|4. **Tests (frontend):** mutation hook test (success notification + refresh,
186|   failure path logs without crashing), button-state test (completed →
187|   shows Uncomplete; after action shows Complete), accessibility (busy state,
188|   label).
189|
190|### Phase 4 — Verification and documentation
191|
192|1. **Automated gates** (primary gate per repo guidance): `npm run test:unit`
193|   (api + frontend suites), plus lint for touched packages. If time allows,
194|   run the full `npm test` runner script path.
195|2. **Manual/isolated check:** with headless tooling only (no long-lived
196|   servers; use existing mock fixtures or `npm run capture:screenshot` if a
197|   visual check is needed): complete a task, confirm the button reads
198|   Uncomplete, uncomplete it, confirm it behaves like any other task (runnable
199|   stage actions visible, board filter includes it, retrospective no longer
200|   counts it completed).
201|3. **Documentation updates** (part of the change, not an afterthought):
202|   - User-facing task lifecycle docs: document Uncomplete where Complete is
203|     described.
204|   - API surface docs if the repo documents task routes (check
205|     `agentGuide`/site-docs coverage gates — `docs:check` validates them).
206|   - CHANGELOG entry if the repo convention covers features.
207|
208|## 4. Validation plan (how we prove it worked)
209|
210|| Check | Command / method | Expected evidence |
211||---|---|---|
212|| Backend unit/integration | `npm run test:api` (covers `taskStore`, `stageTransitions`, route tests) | New uncomplete cases green; no regressions in complete/flow tests |
213|| Frontend unit | `npm run test:frontend` (TaskCard, detail, api.surface suites) | Button-swap and mutation cases green |
214|| Full unit gate | `npm run test:unit` | Green (primary verification gate) |
215|| Lint | `npm run lint:api` + `npm run lint:frontend` for touched files | Clean |
216|| Docs gates | `npm run docs:check` if docs touched | Clean |
217|| Manual round-trip | Isolated/headless run or fixture-driven check | Complete → Uncomplete → runnable task; board/retrospective coherent |
218|
219|## 5. Risks and mitigations
220|
221|- **Wrong restore target** (task reopens into a dead-end stage/status):
222|  mitigate by snapshotting at complete time (exact) + tested fallback, and by
223|  Phase 0's consumer audit.
224|- **Legacy completed tasks** (no snapshot): covered by derivation/`idle`
225|  fallback + explicit test.
226|- **Duplicated button drift**: mitigated by extracting the shared component
227|  before wiring the new action.
228|- **Reports/analytics double-counting** (a task completed, reopened,
229|  completed again): timeline entries make each transition explicit; verify
230|  retrospective stats handle multiple Completed rows or document the caveat.
231|
232|## 6. Open questions (blocked on missing SURVEY.md / idea file)
233|
234|1. **Button wording:** "Uncomplete" (task text) vs "Reopen" — confirm the
235|   survey's chosen label.
236|2. **Restore target confirmation:** exact pre-completion stage+status (with
237|   snapshot) vs simply "back to the queue as idle" — confirm Section 0
238|   assumption 3.
239|3. **Permissions:** is uncomplete allowed for the same actor as complete, or
240|   restricted further?
241|4. **Re-run semantics:** after uncomplete, may the task immediately run the
242|   next stage, or should it require explicit user action? (Plan assumes the
243|   latter.)
